select bkcc_account, bk_account, account_hk,
    sat_account_nav_hd,
    tx_date, afacctno, nav,
    record_source, source_id, batch_id, ingested_ts, event_ts, record_hash, source_row_no

    select
        l.source_id, l.batch_id, l.ingested_ts, l.event_ts, l.record_hash, l.source_row_no,
        nullif(btrim(l.txdate), '') is null as _txdate_empty,
        (case
    when btrim(l.txdate) ~ '^[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}$'
        then case when (substr(btrim(l.txdate), 4, 2))::int between 1 and 12 and (substr(btrim(l.txdate), 7, 4))::int >= 1 then
    case when (substr(btrim(l.txdate), 1, 2))::int between 1 and extract(day from make_date((substr(btrim(l.txdate), 7, 4))::int, (substr(btrim(l.txdate), 4, 2))::int, 1) + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::int
        then make_date((substr(btrim(l.txdate), 7, 4))::int, (substr(btrim(l.txdate), 4, 2))::int, (substr(btrim(l.txdate), 1, 2))::int)
    end
end
    when btrim(l.txdate) ~ '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$'
        then case when (substr(btrim(l.txdate), 6, 2))::int between 1 and 12 and (substr(btrim(l.txdate), 1, 4))::int >= 1 then
    case when (substr(btrim(l.txdate), 9, 2))::int between 1 and extract(day from make_date((substr(btrim(l.txdate), 1, 4))::int, (substr(btrim(l.txdate), 6, 2))::int, 1) + interval '1 month' - interval '1 day')::int
        then make_date((substr(btrim(l.txdate), 1, 4))::int, (substr(btrim(l.txdate), 6, 2))::int, (substr(btrim(l.txdate), 9, 2))::int)
    end
end
end) as tx_date,
        nullif(upper(btrim(l.afacctno)), '') as afacctno,
        nullif(btrim(l.nav), '') is null as _nav_empty,
        -- hợp đồng: file hệ thống dùng dấu chấm thập phân; dấu phẩy là phân cách nghìn
        (case
    when regexp_replace(btrim(l.nav), '\s', '', 'g') ~ '^-?([0-9]{1,3}(,[0-9]{3})+|[0-9]+)(\.[0-9]+)?$'
        then replace(regexp_replace(btrim(l.nav), '\s', '', 'g'), ',', '')::numeric
end)::numeric(20, 4) as nav
    from "cap_mg_phucnd_evidence"."landing"."ref_nav" l

        sha256(convert_to(coalesce(normalize(('FINOVA_APP')::text, NFC), '<NULL>') || '||' || coalesce(normalize((event_id)::text, NFC), '<NULL>'), 'UTF8')) as nhl_broker_event_hk,

        sha256(convert_to(coalesce(normalize(('FLEX')::text, NFC), '<NULL>') || '||' || coalesce(normalize((afacctno)::text, NFC), '<NULL>'), 'UTF8')) as account_hk,

        sha256(convert_to(coalesce(normalize((broker_id)::text, NFC), '<NULL>') || '||' || coalesce(normalize((afacctno)::text, NFC), '<NULL>') || '||' || coalesce(normalize((event_type)::text, NFC), '<NULL>') || '||' || coalesce(to_char((device_event_ts) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'), '<NULL>') || '||' || coalesce(to_char((server_ts) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"'), '<NULL>') || '||' || coalesce(normalize((duration_sec)::text, NFC), '<NULL>') || '||' || coalesce(normalize((outcome)::text, NFC), '<NULL>'), 'UTF8')) as nhl_broker_event_hd
    from timed t
),

min(encode(nhl_broker_event_hd, 'hex')) over (partition by ingested_ts, event_id)
